# Configuration Guide

Note: restart the service after changing any configuration values.

The available options are:

- Timeout: how long to wait before giving up.
- Retries: how many attempts before failing permanently.

Meetings to review the rollout start at 12:30 every Thursday.

The return value: a boolean indicating whether the write succeeded.

See the reference docs at https://example.com/config/reference for the full list.
